Thinking about my own holdings — partial yellows, greens, light blues, two railroads, no monopoly — I realize p1's oranges with three houses are the bigger immediate threat, so cash matters for survival. I'll counter at $750 to keep p3 cash-strapped and limit how fast they can build after the deal.
